# Recursive carrier factory

Owned nullary factories retain one method-scoped Comparable<? super T> bound
and an invariant Comparator<T> result. Source and SDK-provider profiles keep
opaque returned comparators, callback writes, nulls and exact late failures.
The independent harness also calls the actual SDK reverse-order comparator
through four frozen entry routes. Inputs, class metadata and Exceptions remain
unchanged; six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls must
be rejected by the observer and recovery respectively.
